{"notes": "Visit 4, left at 6:30. Picture: one unbroken dark chain from start along the back, round the nose at x=3, down the belly and out to the tail tip near x=28, y=15. No pale dominoes, no gaps; doubled patches (back x=11-14, belly x=17-19) still dark and connected. Fish complete and connected, matching all earlier claims. I still can't attribute individual dominoes, so the result can't be credited to anyone specifically.

Hana: No input this visit. Owned the tail tip, and the tail is finished and connected, consistent with her plan, but I never saw her place it. Leadership remains the strongest evidence: clear roles and handoffs others followed. Execution partly self-reported.

Jack: Said 'Nice one, Omar. Hands off from me, all set for the push.' Positive, recognised a teammate, and stepped back properly. Concrete contribution still unclear; he said he'd watch for gaps and none appeared. Still need to ask him privately what he placed.

Sofia: Reported 'All set here. Hands off' at 6:15. Consistent with the picture and her earlier belly report. Reliable, collaborative, stayed in her lane. Still need to ask her privately what she placed.

Omar: Said nothing this visit, but Jack credited him ('Nice one, Omar'), which is peer evidence, though vague on what for. Earlier he verified the middle section accurately. Still don't know what he built; ask privately.

No ratings yet. Before the review: ask each person privately what they placed, and ask what Jack's praise of Omar referred to. Without that, individual impact and execution rest on self-reports and peer remarks. Final result is good, with the push still to come."}
